bodies.name: Народно събрание (National Assembly of Bulgaria)
bodies.layout: A modern single-page application built on Vue.js (evidenced by the `<v-header>`, `<v-footer>`, and `<router-view>` custom elements in the served markup), meaning all substantive content — news, bill text, session agendas — is rendered client-side after JavaScript execution rather than present in the initial HTML response. The static shell reveals a `v-header-top` utility bar and `v-header` main menu wrapping a router outlet, styled through a UIkit-based design system (uikit.min.css) layered with a custom app.css theme using a dark navy-and-sky-blue institutional palette. RSS feed alternates in the document head (news, bills, laws, decisions, plenary schedule) indicate the underlying content model mirrors a traditional legislative tracking site even though the presentation layer is a modern SPA.
ui_patterns: Vue.js single-page app shell with router-view content injection (no server-rendered article text)
UIkit component framework as the base design system, overlaid with custom theming
extensive RSS/Atom feed alternates exposed in <head> for news, bills, laws, decisions, and plenary agenda
F5 BIG-IP anti-bot / performance cookie script embedded directly in page markup (f5_cspm)
RTL stylesheet variant (uikit-rtl.min.css) loaded defensively alongside the LTR default
hashed/versioned asset URLs (app.css?id=..., app.js?id=...) for cache-busting on each deploy
separate manifest/vendor/app JS bundle split typical of a Webpack-built Vue application
SEO meta tags (robots, googlebot, revisit-after) suggesting active indexing concerns despite JS-rendered content

bodies.name: Министерски съвет (Council of Ministers / PM Office)
bodies.layout: A Bootstrap-based server-rendered site with a fixed-position header bar carrying a Ukraine-solidarity banner, a centered 'Министерски съвет Република България' wordmark logo, and an EU-co-funding badge stacked above a dark-navy horizontal nav bar (Правителство, Пресцентър, Администрация, Антикорупция) that expands into full-width flyout panels on hover. Below a full-bleed LightSlider hero carousel of the current news lead, a 'Новини' (News) section splits into an asymmetric two-thirds/one-third grid of image-led story cards with publication dates and short descriptions. A parallax background section follows with two centered call-to-action buttons ('Заседания на МС' / 'Система за правна информация'), and the footer is a dense four-column block of contact details, office addresses, and an OECD partnership logo.
ui_patterns: dedicated top-level 'Антикорупция' (Anti-corruption) nav item with a 24-hour hotline and email for reporting abuse of power
Ukraine-solidarity banner ('BGforUkraine') and euro-adoption campaign banner ('evroto.bg') both pinned in the header
EU co-funding disclosure badge (Съфинансирано от Европейския съюз) embedded directly in the header chrome
LightSlider jQuery carousel for the homepage hero news item
parallax scroll section housing two centered pill-shaped CTA buttons
asymmetric 2/3 + 1/3 news-card grid rather than uniform equal-width cards
accessibility shortcut link 'За намалено зрение' (For reduced vision) in the footer utility column
government session communique archive (Заседания и решения на МС) as a persistent nav sub-item

bodies.name: Министерство на вътрешните работи (Ministry of Interior / National Police)
bodies.layout: A modern Bootstrap 5 site with a deep-navy fixed header holding a slim utility strip (e-Services, government.bg, sitemap, contacts) above a centered ribbon-style logo lockup reading 'Република България / Министерство на вътрешните работи' in the self-hosted Gilam typeface, echoing the Rijkshuisstijl-style centered crest convention seen across EU institutional sites. The main nav is a hamburger-collapsible mega-menu with deeply nested multi-level flyouts (Министерството → За министерството → Ръководство/Министър/Главен секретар, etc.) reflecting the ministry's large organizational hierarchy. The homepage body splits into a two-column widget layout: a left 'Пресцентър' (Press office) news list mixing major operational stories (drug raids, cigarette factory busts) with routine traffic-police bulletins, and a right sidebar of administrative-service widgets (e-services portal, document validity lookup, appointment booking) plus quick-link cards to Traffic Police and MVR recruitment.
ui_patterns: deeply nested multi-level flyout mega-menu (4+ levels deep) reflecting complex ministry org chart
centered ribbon-style institutional logo lockup with stacked country/ministry name text
mixed news stream blending major crime-bulletin headlines with routine daily border-crossing traffic reports
dedicated administrative self-service widget cluster (document validity checks, appointment scheduling, fine payment lookup)
accessibility stylesheet loaded as a separate dedicated file (accessibility.css) rather than inline toggle
leaflet.js interactive map library pre-loaded, likely for station/checkpoint locators
e-Services portal linked externally (e-uslugi.mvr.bg) rather than integrated into the main domain
traffic/border-crossing wait-time bulletins published on a near-daily cadence as first-class news items
